purpose: Immutable comparison rules for V1.1 experiments against the frozen V1.0 control.

data_splits.training: Fit candidate models only on training data.
data_splits.validation: Select models and hyperparameters only on validation data.
data_splits.calibration: Use only the declared calibration split when calibration is applicable.
data_splits.final_test: Locked until the protocol, intervention, and selection decision are recorded.

leakage_rules: Do not use post-failure telemetry for a pre-failure decision.
Do not insert target outcomes into prior memory.
Do not tune on the final test split.
Do not select final thresholds on the final test split.
calibration: Calibration data must be declared in protocol.json and must not be the locked final test.

randomness.seed_policy: Record every seed in the contract and per_seed artifacts.
deterministic_requirements: Stable identifiers use SHA-256 over canonical JSON.
Do not use Python hash() for scientific identifiers.
Record software version, repository commit, protocol hash, and artifact identity.
randomness.environment_recording: Record interpreter, dependency lock, platform, and repository commit.

decision_rules.trade_off: Improves one dimension while degrading another.
decision_rules.no_meaningful_change: No evidence that the intervention is worth integrating.
decision_rules.interesting_finding: Reveals an important behavioral, scientific, or architectural property without directly improving the system.
